title: Independent derivation of the 5|2|5|2|3|2|5|2|5 mirror lattice
purpose: Connect the pre-existing strict-palindrome five-variable grammar v0.34 with the independently observed bidirectional-tanka seam geometry v1.28, showing that the same nine-cell lattice follows from the union of forward and reverse 5/7/5/7/7 metrical boundaries.

derivation.strict_grammar_formula: A5 | B2 | C5 | D2 | E3 | reverse(D)2 | reverse(C)5 | reverse(B)2 | reverse(A)5

structural_interpretation: The 5/2/5/2/3/2/5/2/5 lattice is not merely a convenient factorization fitted to the fixed-50 strict palindrome corpus.
It is also the atomic partition created when forward and reverse tanka meter boundaries are overlaid on the same 31-kana coordinate system.
The four 2-kana B/D/reverse(D)/reverse(B) cells are exactly the gaps between forward and reverse metrical seams.
The central E cell is 3 kana because the forward third-ku boundary is at 17 while the mapped reverse third-ku boundary is at 14, leaving a three-kana central overlap.

For a strict self-palindrome, mirror equality additionally forces the right four cells to be reversals of the left four and E to be self-reversing; for a bidirectional distinct-reverse poem, the same seam lattice exists without those equality constraints.

generator_consequences.recommended_internal_representation: retain the nine-cell mirror lattice as the canonical tanka coordinate system
generator_consequences.future_scoring_feature: seam-local lexical/morphological support may be attached to B/D and their mirrored cells because these cells are structurally the two-kana seam-offset zones

safety_rules: The independent derivation validates metrical geometry, not automatic linguistic compatibility of factor swaps.
Do not infer that every two-kana seam cell is a word or morpheme.
Do not relax morphology, scene, semantic-role, or source-confidence gates.
Bidirectional distinct-reverse poems remain outside the strict self-palindrome positive corpus.
No machine naturalness or acceptance label follows from structural convergence.

summary.research_value: high: historical bidirectional material independently explains why the strict palindrome tanka algebra has exactly the observed 5/2/5/2/3/2/5/2/5 shape

next_action: Freeze the nine-cell lattice as structurally well-supported. Further research should focus on linguistic evidence attached to seam cells and human review, not on changing the lattice or adding unconstrained operations.
